settings.title: Why do I sometimes feel a mild stinging or tingling sensation when I apply SKEAM ?
settings.description:
If your body’s magnesium levels are low, applying it topically can cause a slight stinging, tingling, or itching feeling at first. This is not an allergic reaction — magnesium is a natural mineral essential to health.

Your body is simply adjusting to increased magnesium absorption. With gradual, consistent use, this sensation usually fades within a few applications.

settings.title: Any tips for getting the most out of SKEAM ?
settings.description:
Absolutely ! Here are our top tips :

  • Apply common areas include feet, calves (for restless legs/cramps), shoulders, neck, back, and stomach.
  • For maximum absorption, apply to clean skin.
  • Use after a warm shower or bath, when pores are open, for faster and deeper absorption.
  • Massage gently for 30–60 seconds to help the formula penetrate and activate.
  • Apply common areas include feet, calves (for restless legs/cramps), shoulders, neck, back, and stomach.

settings.title: Why choose cream magnesium over magnesium pills ?
settings.description:
Cream magnesium allows direct absorption through the skin into the bloodstream, bypassing the digestive system. This means :

  • Faster results for muscle, nerve, and skin benefits
  • Less risk of digestive discomfort compared to oral supplements
  • The ability to target of discomfort

settings.title: Is SKEAM safe to use during pregnancy ?
settings.description:
Yes, SKEAM is formulated with clean, non-toxic ingredients and is safe for use during pregnancy. Many pregnant customers find it helps with sciatica, restless legs, and muscle cramps.

Magnesium also supports healthy bones, enzyme function, and blood sugar regulation during pregnancy.

As with any new product, we recommend consulting your physician before starting.

settings.title: Is SKEAM safe for children ?
settings.description:
Yes, but we always recommend speaking with your pediatrician before use.

If approved, start with a very small amount and test on a small patch of skin first.

Children’s skin is more delicate, so gradual introduction is best.

settings.title: How long does it take to feel results ?
settings.description: Most customers notice relief within 20–30 minutes of application. For ongoing benefits (sleep improvement, skin hydration, reduced cramps), use daily for at least 1–2 weeks.

settings.title: Can I use SKEAM on my face ?
settings.description: We designed SKEAM for the body, but it can be applied to the face if your skin is not sensitive. Avoid contact with eyes, mouth, and open wounds.

settings.title: What if I don’t get results ?
settings.description: We stand by our 60-day money-back guarantee. If you’re not satisfied, simply contact our customer care team for a full refund — no questions asked.

settings.title: Will SKEAM cure my neuropathy ?
settings.description: No, SKEAM is not a medical cure for neuropathy. However, it can significantly reduce symptoms such as discomfort, tingling, and restlessness, making daily life more comfortable.

settings.title: Can SKEAM help with nighttime neuropathy discomfort ?
settings.description: Yes. Many customers find that applying SKEAM before bed helps calm nerve activity, reduce restless legs, and improve sleep quality.

settings.title: What is the source of the magnesium in SKEAM ?
settings.description:
We use high-purity magnesium chloride sourced from 100% natural mineral deposits.

Our formula combines sub-terranean magnesium and marine magnesium for optimal absorption and skin comfort.

Our magnesium comes from pristine locations such as the Zechstein Sea basin in Northern Europe, the Dead Sea region, and select deposits from the Irish Sea — all carefully tested for quality and purity.
